codeReview.summary: Minimal, correct fix. The Unicode warning emoji (U+26A0 + U+FE0F) at line 602 of NativeFeagiAgentClient.java was replaced with ASCII '[WARNING]' text. The Gradle build configuration was updated to set `options.encoding = "UTF-8"` for all JavaCompile tasks in sdk-native, mirroring the identical pattern already present in sdk-core/build.gradle.kts. Binary analysis confirms no emoji bytes remain. The file still contains ~460 em-dash characters (U+2014) in comments, which are now properly handled by the UTF-8 encoding setting. Both changes are well-placed and follow existing project conventions.
